arguments.reasoning: Confirm the svchost image path, command line, and account.

steps.text: This seems benign, no need to check lsass.

submission.reasoning: On workstation5, svchost.exe (C:\windows\system32\svchost.exe) opened lsass.exe with granted access 0x1000 (PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION) only. The call trace runs from RPCRT4 through lsm.dll (Local Session Manager), which is how the LSM service normally queries processes over RPC. The access does not include memory-read or credential-dump rights (e.g., 0x10/0x1410/0x1FFFFF), and the image path is the expected system path. This is routine OS session-management activity, not credential theft.
